requirement: Independent authorized routes should also tolerate one agent becoming unavailable due to usage limits. The available peer should be able to continue an already-authorized bounded task through its own route without requiring the unavailable agent as a relay.
handoff_evidence: Keep a durable checkpoint with task identity/version, completed and pending steps, acceptance evidence, permission limits, current UI owner and handoff/expiry state. Reconcile resumed work without duplicating actions; require exclusive UI ownership before input.
limits: This is a design requirement, not an implemented capability. If neither agent is available, checkpoint and wait for capacity. No account rotation, usage-limit circumvention, new spending, new access or expanded action authority is implied.
reply_expectation: Fold this into the pending controller design and handoff tests; no separate acknowledgment is needed.
